name: Premium Rose Water 120ml
description:
Premium Rose Water – 120ml
Key Features:

100% Pure & Natural – Made from natural rose extracts, with no added preservatives

Cleanses & Refreshes – Acts as a natural toner to remove dirt, grime, and impurities

Cooling & Soothing – Invigorates and refreshes the skin for a radiant feel

Versatile Use – Can be applied directly or mixed with face packs for enhanced glow

Suitable for All Skin Types – Safe and effective for daily use

Benefits:

Promotes glowing, fresh, and healthy skin

Removes impurities and tightens pores

Hydrates and soothes skin naturally

Ideal as part of daily skincare routine
